[[Necromancer Deldrimor armor]] is the collective name used to refer to the stand alone armor pieces crafted for necromancers by [[Gobrech Stonefoot]] in [[Central Transfer Chamber]]. It is also sometimes referred to as Dwarven armor.

It is made up of the following pieces:
*[[Necromancer Gloomcrest Tunic|Gloomcrest Tunic]]
*[[Necromancer Grim Gloves|Grim Gloves]]
*[[Necromancer Deathlace Leggings|Deathlace Leggings]]
*[[Necromancer Demonhorn Boots|Demonhorn Boots]]

The total cost for all pieces would be 300{{hide}}, 50{{bone}}, 25 {{leather}}, 10{{silk}} and 40{{plat}}
